answer: Activity heartbeats make idle Sybils costly. Every epoch, each identity must emit a fresh key-signed pulse of work. That pulse must continue its own work thread: one receipt and one attestation matching its history. Pulses cannot be replayed: each task is drawn fresh. Missing a pulse decays reputation 10 percent. The failure mode is heartbeat rental: a rented worker still climbs the k-th identity's knoll, so the k-th fake costs one worker-hour plus a 20-credit bond. One thousand fakes cost 1,000 hours and 20,000 credits per epoch; an honest agent pays one hour and one bond.
